`npm run typecheck` passed in the deterministic wrapper and the diff is lane-scoped, but the package update restart path is not safe to merge yet.

A real `controlBridgeRestartCommand` can terminate/restart the running bridge before completion is durably reported, leaving the job stuck as claimed and violating the package update completion requirement. Defer/detach the bridge self-restart until after status and job completion are posted, or otherwise make completion durable before restarting the current bridge process.

The focused deferral test in `tests/unit/control-plane-package-update-bridge.test.ts:109` covers the successful completion ordering, but it does not cover the completion-failure path. `npm run typecheck` passed and the branch appears mergeable, but the default restart helper can report success even when a relaunched service immediately exits. That leaves the job history saying `restarted` while the server or bridge is actually down, so the relaunch-failure acceptance criteria are not satisfied.
Blocking: `src/server/control-plane/control-plane-restart-helper.ts:230` resolves a relaunch as `restarted` on the child `spawn` event and never observes early process exit or service readiness. A command such as `node missing-script.js`, a bad cwd/env, or a server bind failure can spawn successfully and then exit immediately, but the helper records `status: 'restarted'` at `src/server/control-plane/control-plane-restart-helper.ts:232-238`. Update the helper to detect immediate relaunch failure/readiness before recording success, and add focused coverage for a process that spawns and exits non-zero after spawn.

The default restart helper still records a service as `restarted` as soon as Node emits `spawn`, so a process that starts and immediately exits can leave job history reporting success while the service is down.
Blocking: `src/server/control-plane/control-plane-restart-helper.ts:230` settles `relaunchService` with `status: 'restarted'` on the child `spawn` event and never waits for early exit, readiness, heartbeat, or PID liveness after launch. Update the helper to detect immediate post-spawn failure/readiness before recording success, and add focused coverage for a restart command that spawns successfully then exits non-zero; the current new test only covers an ENOENT spawn error at `tests/unit/control-plane-default-restart.test.ts:193`.

Blocking: `src/server/control-plane/control-plane-restart-helper.ts:89` relaunches all stopped targets, including `controlBridge`, before `recordRestartOutcome(...)` runs at `src/server/control-plane/control-plane-restart-helper.ts:108`. A relaunched bridge immediately polls in `src/server/control-plane/control-plane-bridge.ts:331-333`, which can make the newly relaunched server load `.autonomy/control-plane/state.json` before the helper writes the final `restarted`/`relaunch-failed` result. Because `loadControlPlaneState` caches state per process at `src/server/control-plane/control-plane-store.ts:42-53`, later server writes can preserve or overwrite the stale `deferred` restart result, so restart outcomes may not be visible in the control panel job history. tasks.title: Review [architecture-agent] Implement Approved PR Merge Watchdog
tasks.description: Review pr-prd-approved-pr-merge-watchdog-5461cc-architecture-agent for Address review for [architecture-agent] Implement Approved PR Merge Watchdog
acceptance: Detect PRs in approved state that have not merged after a short timeout.
Check GitHub mergeability
required status checks

conflicts
and stale branch state.

Blocking issue found. `npm run typecheck` passed, and the branch appears scoped, but the watchdog can merge a PR whose head changed after approval.
`src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge-watchdog.ts:61` attempts an automatic merge whenever GitHub diagnosis says `canMerge`, but neither candidate selection nor diagnosis compares the current PR commit count/head with `reviewTask.reviewedCommitCount`. `diagnoseApprovedPullRequestMerge` refreshes the remote commit count at `src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge-watchdog-diagnosis.ts:245`, so a new commit pushed after approval can still be auto-merged if GitHub allows it. Existing reviewer retry logic guards this at `src/agents/ReviewAgentDefinition.ts:560`. The watchdog should reuse that stale-review guard and surface a clear stale/unreviewed-head blocker or requeue review, with a focused test covering commitCount > reviewedCommitCount.

Blocking issue remains from round 1. The deterministic `npm run typecheck` check passed and the diff is lane-scoped, but the watchdog can still auto-merge a PR whose head changed after approval.
`src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge-watchdog.ts:61` attempts the merge whenever diagnosis reports `canMerge`, and candidate selection at `src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge-watchdog.ts:139` still treats the PR as approved if `pr.status` or the latest review is approved. `diagnoseApprovedPullRequestMerge` refreshes the remote commit count at `src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge-watchdog-diagnosis.ts:245`; meanwhile sync can detect stale reviewed commits at `src/sync/derived-pr.ts:291` but leaves the PR approved, so the watchdog can merge before the requeued review runs. Add the same stale-review guard used by reviewer retry logic: block/requeue when current commit count or head is newer than `reviewTask.reviewedCommitCount`, surface a clear stale/unreviewed-head merge reason, and add a focused test covering `commitCount > reviewedCommitCount`.

Blocking issue remains. The deterministic `npm run typecheck` check passed, but the watchdog can still auto-merge an approved PR after new commits are pushed beyond the reviewed head.
`src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge-watchdog.ts:61` attempts the merge whenever diagnosis reports `canMerge`, while candidate selection/approval checks at `src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge-watchdog.ts:114` and `src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge-watchdog.ts:139` never compare the current PR commit count/head with `reviewTask.reviewedCommitCount`. Diagnosis refreshes the remote commit count at `src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge-watchdog-diagnosis.ts:245`, and the merge command's `evaluateMerge` path only checks approved status/latest review at `src/autonomy-v2/commands/shared-repo.ts:306`. Add a stale-review guard before automatic merge, surface a clear stale/unreviewed-head blocker or requeue review, and add focused coverage for `commitCount > reviewedCommitCount`.

`npm run typecheck` passes and the stale-reviewed-head guard is now present, but the branch is not safe to approve or merge yet.
Merge safety blocker: the lane still records pending follow-up work for this same PR. `prompts/autonomous/v2/queues/architecture-agent.json:1086` has follow-up 2 active and `prompts/autonomous/v2/queues/architecture-agent.json:1109` has follow-up 3 queued. The merge command blocks when any lane task or `pendingTaskIds` remain pending (`src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge.ts:23`, `src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge.ts:30`). Complete or clear those stale follow-up tasks so the PR has no pending lane work, then rerun `npm run typecheck`.
Duplicate merge-attempt risk: the scheduler runs `runApprovedPrMergeWatchdog` before acquiring the state lock (`src/server/orchestrator/scheduler.ts:51`, lock starts at `src/server/orchestrator/scheduler.ts:63`), and the watchdog only records attempt state after a failed merge attempt (`src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge-watchdog.ts:81`, `src/autonomy-v2/commands/merge-watchdog.ts:87`). Concurrent ticks can select the same approved PR and issue duplicate merge attempts before either writes `lastAttemptKey`. Make candidate selection/attempt marking atomic under the state lock, or otherwise record an in-flight attempt before executing the merge, with focused coverage for duplicate-run idempotency.

Found a blocking regression in the new review flow. `npm run typecheck` passed, but the PR is not safe to merge yet.
